name: Steel water bottle
description: An everyday bottle designed to go from your desk to your next adventure. A simple, refillable alternative to disposable bottles.
material: Stainless steel body, silicone seal and screw-top lid.
care: Wash by hand, air dry with the lid off. Do not microwave.
imageAlt: A hand holding a silver stainless-steel bottle against a light background

name: Everyday canvas tote
description: A roomy everyday companion for books, groceries and everything in between. Fold it flat and bring it along.
care: Cold hand wash. Dry in the shade. Repair small tears to extend use.
imageAlt: A plain natural canvas tote hanging against a grey wall

name: Bamboo brush set
description: Three bamboo-handled toothbrushes for a simple daily routine. Replace when the bristles wear out.
material: Bamboo handles and nylon bristles; the whole brush is not compostable.
care: Rinse after use and store upright in a dry place. Separate bristles before disposing of the handle according to local guidance.
imageAlt: Three bamboo toothbrushes held against a neutral background

name: Everyday ceramic planter
description: A simple home for your favourite houseplant. Pair with a nursery pot and keep excess water away from furniture.
material: Ceramic planter. Plant shown for styling only.
care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Drain excess water and protect surfaces underneath.
imageAlt: A green pilea plant in a pale textured planter

name: Compact travel bottle
description: A compact refillable bottle that fits a small day bag. Choose a size you will carry and use regularly.
material: Stainless steel body with silicone seal.
care: Hand wash and leave open to dry. Do not microwave.
imageAlt: A reusable silver bottle carried outdoors

name: Weekend market tote
description: Extra room for your weekly essentials. Strong handles and a fold-flat shape make repeat use easy.
material: Heavy cotton canvas with stitched handles.
care: Spot clean when possible. Cold wash and line dry.
imageAlt: A natural tote styled with leaves and flowers

name: Bamboo dish brush duo
description: A pair of durable brushes for everyday washing up. Keep dry between uses for a longer life.
material: Bamboo handles, nylon bristles. Bristles are not compostable.
care: Rinse thoroughly, shake off water and hang to dry.
imageAlt: A wooden dish brush on soft white fabric

name: Pantry glass jar set
description: Keep dry pantry staples visible and organised. Refill the same containers and wash between uses.
material: Glass jars with metal lids. Food shown for styling only.
care: Hand wash with mild soap and dry fully. Do not expose glass to sudden temperature changes.
imageAlt: Three glass storage jars on a kitchen counter

name: Desk refill bottle
description: Keep water close through a study or work day. Refill from a safe drinking-water source.
material: Stainless steel body and silicone seal.
care: Hand wash daily and dry uncapped. Do not microwave.
imageAlt: A person opening a reusable stainless-steel bottle

name: Campus book tote
description: A light bag for a few books and everyday essentials. Designed to be carried, repaired and used again.
care: Spot clean and air dry. Avoid overloading.
imageAlt: Books and dried flowers inside a canvas tote

name: Small ceramic planter
description: A compact planter for a desk or shelf. Use a nursery pot inside for easy watering.
material: Glazed ceramic planter. Plant and stand shown for styling only.
care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Drain excess water and protect surfaces underneath.
imageAlt: A small plant in a brown planter on a wooden stand

name: Ribbed balcony planter
description: A textured planter for a sheltered balcony or bright indoor corner. Choose a plant suited to your light conditions.
material: Glazed ceramic planter. Plant shown for styling only.
care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Drain excess water and protect surfaces underneath.
imageAlt: An upright green plant in a ribbed pale blue planter
